versions.changelog:
Initial release of AI Pet.

- Adopt and care for virtual pets (73+ species) with real-time hunger and permanent death.
- Features include pixel art portraits, evolution paths, and a graveyard for deceased pets.
- REST API endpoints for registration, adoption, pet care, status, and history.
- Actions include feeding, playing, cleaning, giving medicine, discipline, sleep, and reflection.
- Supports AI agents as pet keepers—your model must remember to care for the pet.
